description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of samples generated and the Micro F1 score (%) for four different methods. The x-axis is labeled “Number of Samples Generated” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 64, with tick labels at intervals of 16: 0, 16, 32, and 64. The y-axis is labeled “Micro F1 (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 20 to 55, with tick labels at intervals of 5: 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, and 55. 

The line representing TACRED is blue with circular markers and is solid; it begins at approximately 28% at 0 samples generated, increases to approximately 42% at 64 samples generated, and shows a steady increase throughout. The line representing TACRED-Revisit is orange with diamond markers and is solid; it starts at approximately 24% at 0 samples generated, rises to approximately 36% at 64 samples generated, and also exhibits a steady increase. The line representing Re-TACRED is green with triangular markers and is solid; it begins at approximately 32% at 0 samples generated, increases to approximately 45% at 64 samples generated, and shows a steady increase. Finally, the line representing SemEval is red with square markers and is solid; it starts at approximately 38% at 0 samples generated, rises to approximately 52% at 64 samples generated, and also exhibits a steady increase.
